title: Extract linked-record callback tables
changes: Extend the European linked-records4 resource with three independently rooted callback partitions containing 107 original Thumb pointers; guest indices, dispatch and reads outside the physical ownership remain unchanged. Sixteen bytes were unowned in the E172 sample.
validation: Source e192-callback-source-vgus1zn1 authenticates the 428 bytes, original readers and distinct successor. Wine e192-callback-trace-wine-i99518dm observes all three tables; e192-callback-wine-rg_ejxyn preserves previous records and 121 other resources, rejects coherent edits, checks altered and mixed reads and compares three interpreter/native branch entries.

Wine e192-callback-scene-wine-ditx_b0y matches full state, guest clock, video, OAM, dispatch and audio for 600 frames with all 428 source bytes altered. Wine e192-callback-cli-wine-yzo92bp7 creates, reuses and verifies 123 matching files.
limitations: The reader and scene logs each contain a D-Bus pending-call assertion before successful test completion; its cause is unestablished. Other callers and paths, old revision-pinned records4 fixtures, Linux, USA and native Windows remain pending. Ordinary traced reads used interpreter fallback; no performance measurements were performed.
